Name: Sword and Sorcery Paintings
Author: vikich3rry
Description:
[size=1][s]I love Mateo way too much so of course I'm gonna stay up until 6am just to plaster their face all over my house[/s] Ended up doing the same for Hector lol[/size]

In the highly unlikely chance you are interested in this mod but don't know what [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12369]Sword & Sorcery[/url] is or who Mateo and Hector are, go check [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12369]S&S[/url] out and download it! 20/10 mod, you won't regret it! Of course, you'll need that mod for this one to work, since these are just paintings of its NPCs - and why would you have a painting of an NPC that doesn't exist in your game?

If you do know about / have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12369]S&S[/url], but you didn't get far yet, maybe you should wait a bit more until you get this - some of the paintings feature things that are light spoilers! [size=1](although they are all in the images tab, so if you saw those you already got spoiled...oops) (it's nothing too big anyway-)[/size][line]
[color=#a2c4c9][size=3][b][i]Features[/i][/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Adds a bunch of in-game paintings as new furniture (doesn't replace anything!)
[*]Get the new paintings at Robin's for 500g, from the Furniture Catalogue, or spawn them with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url]﻿
[*]Choose the wood color of the frame: Oak, Walnut, Birch, Mahogany, Wizard, Retro, Junimo or Joja [size=1](so basically every vanilla option)[/size]
[*]Currently includes paintings of Mateo and Emeritus, and Hector and Book
[*]Enable/disable overlays for Mateo's horns, scars and mermaid earring - you can mix and match them however you want!
[*]Enable/disable Hector's heterochromia overlay!
[*]Also includes three flags: one with Mateo's colors and two with Hector's - these were shared with me by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Acc9000]Acc9000[/url]﻿!
[/list]
Please check the images to see each painting and their sizes! [size=1](The portraits ones are biggg)[/size][line]

[*]Add Cirrus too [size=1](she deserves more love okay)[/size]
[/list][line]
